rows.notes: PyPI's history displays Nov 2, 2026 in its local time display; its release timestamp is 2026-11-03 UTC.

The PyPI project HTML page presented a CAPTCHA, so I used PyPI's opened JSON metadata endpoint; its exact requires_python value is >=3.11. The opened Weaviate docs page still named v4.24.1, while PyPI metadata and the GitHub Releases page showed v4.25.0.
The Releases page also shows a separate prerelease tagged latest and labeled Latest Pre-release; stable release 1.5.9 is marked Latest.
The PyPI page and Moss docs identify moss as the Python SDK. The repository's release marked Latest is v0.17.0 for the iOS SDK, not the Python SDK.

summary_text: Weaviate's Python SDK has the most recent stable PyPI release among the verified vendors, version 4.25.0 on 2026-11-26, followed by Moss 1.26.0 on 2026-11-23. I could not verify an official Python SDK for Zyphrelon Vector Cloud.
